2608.02407.title: Antares: Foundation Models for Agentic Vulnerability Localization
2608.02407.paper_summary: Vulnerability localization is a fundamental step in software security, requiring models to reason over large codebases and iteratively identify vulnerable implementations. We present Antares, a family of compact language models (350M, 1B, and 3B parameters) for agentic vulnerability localization. Based on IBM Granite base models, Antares is trained through a two-stage pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning on cybersecurity reasoning and repository exploration data with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards over vulnerable repositories. Across extensive evaluations, Antares-3B approaches GPT-5.5 while outperforming open-weight models over 200x larger in size. The Antares family further enables fast, low-cost local inference, completing a full 500-task evaluation sweep in approximately 15 minutes on a single H100 GPU, corresponding to an amortized evaluation time of under 2 seconds and less than $0.002 per task.
2608.02407.paper_summary_zh: 脆弱性定位是軟體安全中的一個基本步驟，需要模型對大型代碼庫進行推理，並迭代地識別脆弱的實現。我們提出了 Antares，一系列緊湊的語言模型（350M、1B 和 3B 參數）用於代理脆弱性定位。基於 IBM Granite 基礎模型，Antares 通過一個兩階段的流程進行訓練，該流程結合了對網絡安全推理和代碼庫探索數據的監督微調，以及來自可驗證獎勵的強化學習，這些獎勵來自脆弱的代碼庫。在廣泛的評估中，Antares-3B 接近 GPT-5.5，同時在規模上超越了開放權重模型，達到 200 倍以上的優勢。Antares 系列進一步實現了快速、低成本的本地推理，單個 H100 GPU 上完成 500 項任務的全面評估掃描大約需要 15 分鐘，對應的平均評估時間少於 2 秒，每項任務的成本低於 $0.002。
